title: Useless but Cool Additions
description: Inspired by the chaos of April Fool's Day updates, this mod brings a series of useless, questionable, and strangely fun features.

> *Inspired by Minecraft's April Fools updates.*

**Useless but Cool Additions** is a mod inspired by Minecraft's official **April Fools** updates. Its goal is to add a variety of new content that may be useful, questionable, or completely unnecessary.

Most additions are designed to be discovered naturally during gameplay. Because of that, this page only showcases a few examples of what you might encounter.

---

## Highlights

### Wooden Bat

An early-game item capable of applying a **ridiculously excessive amount of knockback** to any creature without dealing damage.

**Features:**

* Deals no damage.
* Launches mobs far away.
* Produces a satisfying **"bonk!"** sound.

---

### Legendary Artifact

A mysterious artifact that can be obtained in several ways:

* Through trades with a Wandering Trader.
* Magically obtained after taming a wolf.

But one question remains:

> What happens if you give the artifact to a tamed wolf?

*Inspired by Undertale.*

---

### Music Discs

The mod adds a large collection of music discs, including:

* **Magnetic Circuit**, a track created by Notch that was accidentally included in Minecraft Java Edition Alpha v1.1.1.
* Various tracks from Minecraft's official albums composed by C418.

---

## Random Additions

Some additions exist simply because they can.

* Tilling dirt may drop seeds.
* Using a shovel on grass may drop flowers.
* Zombies can spawn holding Wooden Bats.
* Zombies can spawn riding wolves.
* And many other random mechanics scattered throughout the game.

---

## Development

**Useless but Cool Additions** is not a finished project.

The mod will continue to receive new ideas, content, and experiments over time. Whenever something funny, interesting, or unnecessary enough comes to mind, there's a good chance it will end up being added.

---

## Notes

Not every feature will be documented here.

Part of the fun is discovering them on your own.
